about.body: WEblok is a library of ready-made blocks for embedding in websites - every block can be edited live and exported as standalone code, no need to build everything from scratch.
about.creatorTitle: Built with love by Y.M. Mauas
about.creatorSubtitle: Yeshiva student aspiring to be a Torah scholar, coding in my free time for fun...
hero.title1: Smart blocks that plug into your site
hero.subtitle: Pick a block, style it in a live editor, and get ready-to-embed code - no exposed API keys, no building from scratch.
journey.f1.title: Ready blocks, not templates
journey.f1.text: Every block is built for live editing - change values and see the result instantly, no touching code.
journey.f2.title: Safe API keys
journey.f2.text: Your keys are stored server-side only. The embed code that goes on your site never exposes them.
journey.f3.title: AI-assisted editing
journey.f3.text: Registered users with their own API key can ask the AI to update and improve the design directly.
journey.f4.title: From editor to live site
journey.f4.text: Copy one short snippet and paste it on your site - the block goes live instantly.

about.privacy.intro: WEblok collects and stores only the data needed to run the service - nothing more. This page explains, in plain language, what is stored, how it's protected, and why.
about.privacy.dataBody: Your name, email, and account role (user/admin), the blocks and projects you've saved, and messages sent through the contact form. That's it.
about.privacy.keysBody: If you choose to store an API key on the server, it is encrypted before storage - nobody, including us, can read it as plain text from the database. You can also choose to keep it in your browser only, so it never reaches our server.
about.privacy.rlsBody: The database is built so each user can only see and touch their own data - enforced at the database level itself, not just in the website's design, so even a code bug can't expose someone else's data.
about.privacy.openSourceBody: The site's source code is publicly visible on GitHub. It never includes personal information or secrets - keys and passwords always live outside the code itself.
about.privacy.contact: Questions about privacy? Reach out through the contact form on the site.
about.accessibility.intro: WEblok places great importance on making the site accessible to the general public, including people with disabilities. We work to keep the site accessible, clear, and easy to use for everyone.
about.accessibility.levelBody: The site is built following the recommendations of WCAG 2.1 level AA by the W3C.
about.accessibility.a1: The site is responsive - suited for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
about.accessibility.a3: Headings used for content structure and hierarchy.
about.accessibility.a5: Adequate color contrast, in both dark and light mode.
about.accessibility.contactBody: We keep working to improve the site's accessibility. If you run into an issue or have a suggestion, we'd love to hear from you - through the contact form on the site.

inject.title: Inject into existing project
inject.subtitle: Upload your site's HTML file, pick a block, and the AI adds it in the right place - without touching the rest of your code. Everything happens in your browser: the file is never uploaded to our server.
inject.step1: Upload one HTML file from your site (e.g. index.html).
inject.step2: Pick the blocks to add - with default settings, or as you designed them in the editor.
inject.step3: Enter a personal Gemini key (not stored on any server) and describe where the block should go - or choose simple injection without AI.
inject.step4: Check the before/after preview and download the updated file.
inject.privacyBody: The file is read and edited only in your browser and is never sent to WEblok's server. With AI injection, the file and blocks are sent directly from your browser to Google Gemini using your key, under Google's terms. We never store the key.
inject.dropHere: Drop an HTML file here, or click to choose

inject.simpleHint: The blocks are added at the end of the page (before </body>) exactly as they are - no key, nothing sent anywhere. Nothing existing is changed.

inject.keyHint: The key stays on this page only and is sent directly to Google - not to our server.

inject.notesPlaceholder: e.g. put the contact form above the footer, inside the main container
inject.guidelinesTitle: The fixed instructions the AI receives
inject.guidelinesIntro: Every injection sends these rules to the AI up front. The result is also checked automatically: the AI returns only targeted additions, and we verify each one is anchored to code that really exists in your file and that every block was added.

inject.err.no_edits: The AI couldn't find a suitable place in the file. Try adding placement notes, or use simple injection.
